text:
elaine: Following up from the postmortem (INC-2026-03-18). Capturing owners and a short timeline so we can close actions. Please ack and call out missing items.

elaine: ACTION LIST:
- emergency quota: submit cloud support ticket + follow-up escalation (owner: ajay, ETA: 2026-03-23)
- scheduler tuning: reduce preemption window, adjust binpack scoring, add descheduler rule for noise (owner: tom, ETA: 2026-03-22)
- cluster headroom: define headroom policy per workload class and simulation plan (owner: kevin, ETA: 2026-03-29)
- autoscale test harness: replay spike + validate controller reaction for 30s-5min windows (owner: maria, ETA: 2026-03-27)
- runbook + telemetry: add surge tags, KPI list, and emergency play for cost rollback (owner: elaine, ETA: 2026-03-21)

ajay: Ack. I'll open the emergency quota ticket now and attach required SKUs. Will include a short justification and expected durations.

tom: Ack. Plan: preemption window 120s -> 30s, enable soft-affinity binpack, descheduler rule to evict <100ms background pods first. Will post canary config to eng-infra.

maria: Ack. For the harness I need 2x GPUs on staging for a 3 hour window. Who can approve scheduling?

ajay: I'll escalate to infra budget owners and cc @maria with proposed windows.

kevin: For headroom sims I propose starting with 15% for prod clusters, 25% for p99-heavy pods. I'll run replay across two regions and share results. Need sanitized spike trace.

elaine: Spike trace uploaded to the postmortem doc: https://redwood.internal/postmortems/INC-2026-03-18/trace-sample. Use fields: ts, req_type, tokens.

ops-bot: Reminder set: "GPU capacity remediation" starting 2026-03-24 09:00 PT (recurrence: weekly). Assigned to: elaine, ajay, tom.

maria: One question — for scheduler binpack, we need to measure impact on tail latency for small requests. Tom, can the canary emit p50/p95 token latency and preemption_count?

tom: Yes. Canary will push metrics to the test metrics namespace. I'll include p50/p95, preemption_count, and controller scale latency. Rollback condition: if p95 increases >5% or preemptions spike >2x.

ajay: Created ticket CLOUD-6789 for quota request: https://cloud.vendor/support/CLOUD-6789. I added provider contacts and requested SKUs.

maria: For autoscale policy changes, we should also add a short smoke test that runs in CI to detect regressions. I'll open a PR in infra-tests.

kevin: One constraint: eu-west has lower provider headroom; fallback should prefer us-west. I'll add that to the routing doc.

elaine: Good catch. Adding eu-west constraint to runbook now.

maria: Example local run command for the harness:

kubectl run spike-test --image=redwood/loadgen:stable --restart=OnFailure -- /bin/sh -c "python replay_spike.py --trace trace-sample.json --duration 600"

elaine: Next steps recap: 1) owners ack (done) 2) ajay files quota + escalate by 03/23 3) tom posts canary and starts 03/22 4) kevin runs headroom sim by 03/29 5) maria runs autoscale harness by 03/27 6) weekly check-ins until green. If any ETA slips >48h, escalate to eng-sre lead.

tom: I'll tag results back here after canary.

ajay: Noted. Will update incident tracker and link tickets.

elaine: Thanks everyone — I'll consolidate into the postmortem doc and send calendar invites for the weekly sync. :white_check_mark:
